topics.title: Radio Show & Godzilla
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio broadcast, hosts debate the actions of an unnamed individual and nearly get suspended for playing 'Godzilla goes to Harlem.' They discuss past controversies including a fired program director’s claims about hypnotizing crowds and a girlfriend named Orna, ultimately planning to replay another controversial bit.

topics.title: Stern and Fred Wrestle with Harmony and Mattress Troubles
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses his frustration with Fred’s attempts at musical harmony during a show bit. He then transitions into a conversation about mattress comfort after watching a teen movie featuring suggestive scenes that failed to provide relaxation, leading to annoyance over the film's lack of explicit content.

topics.title: Teenage Girl's Sexual Encounter & Tangents
topics.summary: Jeanette recounts her sister’s attempted seduction, culminating in the girl participating and feeling disgusted afterward. The conversation quickly devolves into unrelated discussions about movie references (Summer of People), actor names, bizarre personal anecdotes involving fire acts, and a general stream-of-consciousness digression.

topics.title: Godzilla Sighting in Harlem
topics.summary: Police Commissioner Iron Bottom reports a possible Godzilla sighting near 125th Street in Harlem after receiving an all-points bulletin. A group of individuals, including 'Turkey,' attempt to collect money from the creature and engage in chaotic behavior before being apprehended.

topics.title: Listener Calls & Phone Company Strike
topics.summary: Howard discusses calls from listeners, including stuttering lineman Quinton and his entourage. He addresses the ongoing phone company strike, questioning management’s priorities regarding worker health benefits while also discussing tangents about booch, wild thing concert plans, gary's dental experiments, and a potential health plan for striking workers.

topics.title: Tennis Contestant’s Unsuccessful Scoring Attempt
topics.summary: A man with a stutter attempts to score tennis points during the live broadcast, frequently interrupting himself and prompting commentary from hosts Robin and Darren.
